Frames frame_wall_ms is the round-41 scope: Session::updateSource plus run, excluding decode, comparison and JSON. A faster method is named only when every paired block agrees with the pooled medians. Profile runs carry encoder timestamps and never enter time gates.
memory_note: Peak process RSS, named Metal buffer lengths and hybrid pose-context buffers are separate scopes and are never added. coarse_score_bytes (score map or ring) and peak_scratch_bytes are parts of the named Metal total.
parity_note: Independent strict GT is evaluated on every first, warm-up (frames) and measured call. Exact ordered matches AND proposals of every peak-mode-2 call against the peak-mode-1 static first call are a separate check.
